title: Interstellar
cast: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain
desc: A space adventure about love, time, survival, and humanity finding a new home.
details: Interstellar tells the story of a former pilot who travels through space to find a new planet for humans. The movie focuses on family love, sacrifice, time, gravity, and the future of Earth. It is emotional, scientific, and visually powerful.

title: The Dark Knight
cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart
desc: A powerful superhero crime story with a legendary villain and strong moral conflict.
details: The Dark Knight follows Batman as he tries to protect Gotham City from the Joker. The movie explores justice, chaos, fear, and moral choices. It is popular because of its strong acting, serious story, and unforgettable villain.

title: Your Name
desc: A romantic anime story about dreams, fate, distance, and two connected lives.
details: Your Name is about two teenagers who mysteriously switch bodies. As they learn about each other, they become emotionally connected. The movie mixes romance, fantasy, memory, time, and destiny in a beautiful anime style.

title: Parasite
cast: Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong
desc: A dark social thriller about class difference, greed, secrets, and survival.
details: Parasite shows the relationship between a poor family and a rich family. It begins like a clever comedy but slowly becomes a dark thriller. The movie talks about class division, money, family pressure, and hidden social problems.

title: La La Land
cast: Ryan Gosling, Emma Stone, John Legend
desc: A colorful musical romance about dreams, career choices, love, and sacrifice.
details: La La Land follows a jazz musician and an actress who are trying to reach their dreams in Los Angeles. The movie is romantic and colorful, but it also shows how ambition and career choices can affect love.

title: Dune
desc: A grand desert science-fiction story filled with politics, power, and destiny.
details: Dune is set on a dangerous desert planet called Arrakis. The story follows Paul Atreides as he faces politics, war, family duty, and destiny. The movie is known for its large world, serious tone, and strong visual design.

title: Joker
cast: Joaquin Phoenix, Robert De Niro, Zazie Beetz
desc: A psychological drama about loneliness, society, and the making of a villain.
details: Joker tells the story of Arthur Fleck, a lonely man who struggles with rejection and society. The movie focuses on mental pressure, social problems, violence, and how a person can slowly change into a dangerous figure.

title: Avengers Endgame
cast: Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Scarlett Johansson
desc: A large-scale superhero finale with teamwork, sacrifice, time travel, and emotion.
details: Avengers Endgame is the final battle of many Marvel heroes after a major loss. The story includes teamwork, time travel, friendship, and sacrifice. It is emotional because many character journeys reach their conclusion.

title: Inception
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page
desc: A mind-bending story about dreams, memories, and reality.
details: Inception is about a team that enters dreams to steal or plant ideas. The movie explores memory, guilt, imagination, and the question of what is real. Its layered dream structure makes it exciting and clever.

title: Spider-Man No Way Home
desc: A superhero story about identity, responsibility, friendship, and second chances.
details: Spider-Man No Way Home follows Peter Parker after his identity becomes public. He asks Doctor Strange for help, but the spell creates serious problems. The movie focuses on responsibility, mistakes, friendship, and growing up.
